card: Adds a `Snapshot` interface to `interfaces::Node` and adds progress notification signals during UTXO snapshot loading. This enables external clients, such as GUI frontends (targeted in GUI PRs #870 and #488) and IPC wrappers, to initiate assumeutxo activations and display real-time progress while populating coins. It also refactors `loadtxoutset` RPC to route through the new interface, consolidating file handling and error handling into the interface layer.
evidence: Author references companion draft PRs in external GUI repos that depend on this interface: bitcoin-core/gui#870 for the Qt widgets GUI and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488 for the QML GUI.
problem: UTXO snapshot loading is tied directly to internal node structures and the `loadtxoutset` RPC, lacking an interface abstraction. GUI callers and multiprocess clients cannot trigger snapshot loading or receive incremental progress updates as coins are validated and populated into the chainstate.
scope_notes: Changes error reporting behavior in `loadtxoutset`: file-opening and metadata-parsing failures now raise `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR` (-32603) instead of `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER` (-8) and `RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR` (-22), updating assertions in `feature_assumeutxo.py`.
summary: Exposes assumeutxo snapshot loading through a new `interfaces::Snapshot` abstraction on `interfaces::Node`, and introduces a progress notification signal during snapshot population. Refactors the `loadtxoutset` RPC handler to operate through this new interface rather than directly accessing `ChainstateManager` and internal file helpers.
